rule: Keep the bearer and exercise graphs fixed while switching real clocks
meaning: Use the existing two-actual-bearer reciprocal esse-supply model, alternating exercise bearer map, and n+1 → n exercise graph. Every even n lies on the identity fibre and receives a path from n+2 via n+1. The discrete clock inherits local finiteness from the negative natural clock, while the even indices give arbitrarily negative times. The reflected Zeno clock sends those infinitely many even indices into [0,1], where local finiteness would force a finite number of indices. This certifies that neither a lower bound alone nor indexed local finiteness alone yields a minimal exercise even with inhabited identity fibres, strict forwardness and backward lifting. The clocks are mathematical controls on that interpretation.
